acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of Answer Engine Optimization for a remodeling business, including in a market like Chicago, is not fixed and depends on several factors. These include the scope of services (e.g., content creation, technical optimization, ongoing monitoring), the competitiveness of your local market, the size of your website, and your specific goals. Packages can range from a few hundred dollars per month for basic services to several thousand for comprehensive strategies. A customized quote is typically provided after an initial assessment of your current online presence and business objectives.
